author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The AI labs are boosting they are merging thousands of PR every day.
Here is my question, why don't they lump the work together, so they don't have too many PRs.
When I was writing code as a human, even if I am working on multiple Jira tickets in parallel, I found it easier to just lump everything into one PR.
No matter how fast or slow I work, I found weekly task assignment and PR is the right pace. I never understand why people do 30 mins PR. If AI can write more code, just make the scope of a PR bigger. Keep it at the same pace.
Do the AI labs do sprint glooming?
